meta.description: Detect transcription factor binding footprints in ATAC-seq using TOBIAS, HINT-ATAC, Wellington, or scprinter. Use when identifying bound TF sites within accessible regions, correcting Tn5 insertion bias before footprinting, choosing between cleavage-based and aggregate-based footprinters, or comparing differential TF activity between conditions.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated results; observed values match independent recomputation and real ENCODE biology.

practice_boundaries.detail: Public ENCODE data; no clinical or sensitive-data handling; single-tool calls labelled exploratory.

methodological_ground.detail: Bias-corrected footprinting is sound; the CTCF-dip gate is circular but does not invalidate the pipeline (FOOT-008).

code_usability.detail: run_tobias.sh ran unmodified to rc 0 on real data on TOBIAS 0.17.5.

functional_suitability.note: TOBIAS path complete and correct; scPrinter, HINT-ATAC, Wellington, PIQ named without procedures

reliability.note: Silent skip of CTCF QC, no output checks between steps, space-in-path failure

performance_context.note: 80-line SKILL.md with routed references; reference file is large but conditional

agent_usability.note: Clear workflow and tool decision table; several stale or unverifiable tool claims

human_usability.note: Natural trigger phrases; positional-argument script and undocumented failure recovery

security.note: No secrets or destructive operations; unquoted expansion and glob handling

maintainability.note: Provenance and MIT license preserved; install line and URL drifted; no pinned environment

agent_specific.note: Description covers goals and four tools; two of four tools lack shipped guidance

CTCF aggregate shows a central dip (flank minus core > 0.5) in both conditions
Top-TF table is ranked by absolute change as its comment states
assertions.note: sorted by p-value; CTCF -0.222 printed above GATA1 -0.385

assertions.text: Dip gate fails when bias correction is removed (negative control)
assertions.note: uncorrected-pipeline bound sites dip 4.44 vs 3.78 corrected

key_strengths: Core TOBIAS pipeline (ATACorrect, ScoreBigwig, BINDetect) is correct and ran unmodified on real ENCODE data with expected biology (GATA1 K562, IRF4/EBF1 GM12878).
NFR filter and +4/-5 Tn5 shift statements were verified numerically against independent counts.
Progressive disclosure is clean: short SKILL.md, routed method reference, provenance and MIT license preserved.
Per-TF failure modes and the exploratory-versus-concordant reporting stance are scientifically careful.

recommendations.title: CTCF validation silently skipped without a CTCF motif
recommendations.problem: With a motif file lacking CTCF, run_tobias.sh exits 0 with an empty validation directory and no message.
recommendations.root_cause: The if [ -f ... ] guard has no else branch.
recommendations.fix: Warn or fail when no CTCF bound bed is found and document alternative controls (FOOT-001).

recommendations.title: scPrinter route not runnable as documented
recommendations.problem: The clone-install line breaks without tangermeme 0.4.4 and snapatac2 2.8.0 and the bundle has no scPrinter procedure although requests advertise scATAC work.
recommendations.root_cause: The tool is named without a tested recipe or version pins.
recommendations.fix: Ship a tested pinned recipe or narrow the claims; update the stale 0.1+ floor (FOOT-002, FOOT-012).

recommendations.title: One-line install resolves TOBIAS 0.13.3 on Python 3.7
recommendations.problem: The documented conda line installs versions below the stated floors; bioconda-only is unsolvable.
recommendations.root_cause: rgt and pydnase pin Python 3.7 in the same environment.
recommendations.fix: Use separate environments and state channels (FOOT-003).

recommendations.title: JASPAR URL 404; stale HINT-ATAC and Wellington guidance
recommendations.problem: The wget URL is 404, rgt-hint needs undocumented data, the Wellington crash claim is contradicted and -A is omitted, the stranded-mode claim is absent from 1.0.2.
recommendations.root_cause: Claims and commands were not executed against current tool versions.
recommendations.fix: Correct the URL and give tested HINT-ATAC and Wellington commands (FOOT-004, FOOT-005, FOOT-010, FOOT-011).

recommendations.title: run_tobias.sh summary order, quoting and QC gate
recommendations.problem: The summary is sorted by p-value though labelled by |change|, unquoted variables break on spaces, and the CTCF dip gate is met even without bias correction.
recommendations.root_cause: Script logic was condensed without checking labels, quoting or the discrimination of the QC.
recommendations.fix: Fix ranking, quote variables and validate the gate at unselected or ChIP-anchored sites (FOOT-006, FOOT-007, FOOT-008).

recommendations.title: Two-tool concordance rule undefined and unmet on real data
recommendations.problem: The >50% overlap rule has no stated denominator; measured values are 40.6% or 15.1% for HINT and 6.3-11.2% for Wellington.
recommendations.fix: Define the statistic and give an empirical expectation (FOOT-009).
